name: What considerations are important when choosing stairway lighting for safety?

mainEntity.name: What considerations are important when choosing stairway lighting for safety?

acceptedAnswer.text: When prioritizing safety, consider illumination levels; the lighting should be bright enough to clearly define each step and any obstacles without causing glare. Placement is crucial, with lights often installed at foot level or under handrails to minimize shadows. Choose durable, low-profile fixtures that won't create tripping hazards. Motion sensors can also enhance safety by automatically illuminating the stairs when someone approaches, preventing fumbling for switches in the dark.
acceptedAnswer.description: For safety, ensure adequate illumination without glare, strategic placement to minimize shadows, and durable, low-profile fixtures. Motion sensors can also enhance safety.
